column1: # The cases npm itself checks its range rules with, as asked of this launcher.
# Taken from node-semver, the implementation npm resolves a dependencies entry with, so that what
# this launcher decides is measured against the rule it claims to follow rather than against cases
# somebody here imagined. Every line is one entry of
# copied as it stands. The entries this launcher answers differently are in npm-differences.tsv,
# with the reason for each; the licence notice is there too.
# Each line is: whether the range should satisfy the version, the range, the version.
